control_entrypoints.name: edge_cdp_broker_preflight
control_entrypoints.scope: 自主启动或复用单一 loopback Edge CDP broker，自动读取当前可见持久 Microsoft Edge 的 DevToolsActivePort；以操作系统级端点互斥锁拒绝第二个 broker，不向用户索要端口或 target。

control_entrypoints.name: edge_cdp_broker_request
control_entrypoints.scope: 以 bearer、稳定随机 request id 和随机 per-target lease capability 执行有界导航、固定只读 DOM 查询、小步滚动、点击、截图、恢复、释放或显式关闭 broker 自建任务页；new 只在复读确认内部 HMAC 标记已消失后发布 lease，new/acquire 支持响应丢失后的幂等恢复，token、request id 和 lease 不进入日志。

control_entrypoints.name: edge_cdp_broker_selftest
control_entrypoints.scope: 仅离线验证 loopback、CDP 正向白名单、安全 selector/DOM schema、URL 脱敏、随机租约能力和同 target 串行队列。

parallelism: OS-enforced one broker per running Edge debugging endpoint even across different broker ports; different targets may run concurrently; one owner and serialized commands per target

security.authentication: per-process random bearer in a fail-closed current-user token file plus idempotent lease creation and random per-target lease capability; orphan markers use a port-scoped persistent HMAC key restricted to the current user and SYSTEM; leases expire after six idle hours without closing pages
forbidden: arbitrary JavaScript or arbitrary CDP method execution
Codex in-app, hosted, headless, or temporary profile control

boundary: Broker 只提供对符合 access-policy 的持久桌面 Edge 页面进行控制的通道；它本身不证明平台范围、主页自然终点、风险扫描或媒体复核完成。禁止与 Codex 浏览器扩展同时控制同一页面。首次出现扩展 CDP 超时、Debugger unattached 或 tab lease 冲突时保存 checkpoint 并切换 broker，不连续重试 30 秒。
